add_subdirectory( ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/AESDK )
if(WIN32)
    add_subdirectory( ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/glad/cmake)
    glad_add_library(glad STATIC REPRODUCIBLE API gl:core=4.5)
    add_subdirectory( ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/glfw)
endif()
if(APPLE)
    add_subdirectory( ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/metal-cpp )
endif()
add_subdirectory( ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake)

add_subdirectory( ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/glm)
add_subdirectory( ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/magic_enum)
add_subdirectory( ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/plog)

set(TBB_TEST OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(TBB_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(TBB_STRICT OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)

set(_extern_build_shared_libs_was_defined OFF)
if(DEFINED BUILD_SHARED_LIBS)
    set(_extern_build_shared_libs_was_defined ON)
    set(_extern_build_shared_libs "${BUILD_SHARED_LIBS}")
endif()

if(APPLE)
    set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "Build shared libraries by default" FORCE)
else()
    set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS ON CACHE BOOL "Build shared libraries by default" FORCE)
endif()

add_subdirectory( ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/oneTBB)

if(_extern_build_shared_libs_was_defined)
    set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS "${_extern_build_shared_libs}" CACHE BOOL "Build shared libraries by default" FORCE)
else()
    unset(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS CACHE)
endif()
unset(_extern_build_shared_libs)
unset(_extern_build_shared_libs_was_defined)

#add_subdirectory( ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/taskflow)

set(gtest_force_shared_crt ON CACHE BOOL "Use the shared MSVC runtime for GoogleTest." FORCE)
add_subdirectory( ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/googletest)
